sn56.45:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasāḷāyaṃ || || 2.
sn56.45:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando pubbaṇhasamayam nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Vesālim piṇḍāya pāvisi || || 3.
sn56.45:1.3: Addasā kho āyasmā Ānando sambahule licchavikumārake santhāgāre upāsanam kāronte durato va sukhumena ṭālacchiggaḷena asanam atipātente poṅkhānupoṅkam avirādhitaṃ || || 4.
sn56.45:1.5: Sikkhitā vatime licchavikumārakā susikkhitā vatime licchavikumārakā
sn56.45:1.6: yatrahi nāma durato va sukhumena taḷacchigaḷena asanam atipātessanti poṅkhānupoṅkham avirādhitan ti || || 5.
sn56.45:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Vesāliyam piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattam piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami ||pe || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 6.
sn56.45:2.2: Idhāham bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Vesālim piṇḍaya pāvisiṃ ||
sn56.45:2.3: addasaṃ khvāham bhante sambahule licchavikumārake santhāgāre upāsanam karonte durato va sukhumena tāḷacchiggaḷena asanam atipātente poṅkhānupoṅkham aviradhitaṃ || ||
sn56.45:2.5: Sikkhitā vatime licchavikumarakā susikkhitā vatime licchavikumārakā
sn56.45:2.6: yatra hi nāma durato va sukhumena tāḷacchiggaḷena asanam atipātessanti poṅkānupoṅkham avirādhitan ti || || 7.
sn56.45:3.2: katamaṃ nu kho dukkarataraṃ vā durabhisambhavataraṃ vā
sn56.45:3.3: yo durato va sukhumena tāḷacchiggaḷena asanam atipāteyya poṅkhānupoṅkham avirādhitaṃ || yo vā satadhā bhinnassa vālassa koṭiyā koṭim paṭivijjheyyā ti || ||
sn56.45:3.4: Etad eva bhante dukkarataraṃ ceva durabhisambhavatarañca yo vā satadhā bhinnassa vālassa koṭiyā koṭim paṭivijjheyyā ti || || 8.
sn56.45:3.5: Atha kho Ānanda duppaṭivijjhataram paṭivijjhanti ye Idam dukkhan ti yathābhūtam paṭivijjhanti || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāmini patipadā ti yathābhutam paṭivijjhanti || || 9.
sn56.45:4.1: Tasmā ti hānanda Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || pa-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo
